description: helpers.rs:21: duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap_or_default() returns 0 duration if the system clock is behind the epoch (e.g., in a sandboxed test environment or a system with a reset clock). This produces the timestamp '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z' for sendAt/receivedAt, which would be stored without any warning. A comment explaining the failure mode would make the intention clear: 'clock regression → epoch; callers should validate receivedAt independently'. Without the comment, a future maintainer removing the unwrap_or_default will not know why it was there.
title: now_utc_string silently returns 1970-01-01 on SystemTime::UNIX_EPOCH regression
